data.body: **[P2] Preserve the known-existing state before the retryable read.** If concurrent creation returns `ResourceConflictException` and all 10 configuration-read attempts are throttled, the error reaches the outer retry before this assignment runs. The next attempt therefore calls `CreateFunction` again for a function already known to exist, adding control-plane load and consuming the deployment retry budget. Set `functionExists` before the read; the existing update branch now refreshes `currentConfig`, so retries remain safe.
